description: This source file contains functions for handling serialization and deserialization of different types of Open vSwitch (OVS) maps and dictionaries in JSON format, primarily used for network configuration or data exchange. It includes generic handlers for OVS maps, as well as specific handlers for integer, boolean, real, string, and UUID types in both mapping and dictionary contexts.
